name: Fujian Mindong Electric Power Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Mindong Electric Power Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and development of hydropower, wind, and photovoltaic power in China. As of December 2024, the company's equity installed capacity is 587,800 kilowatts. It is also involved in the real estate development; new energy project investment; power equipment installation and maintenance; mineral product development and sale business. The company was formerly known as Fujian Mindong Electric Power Limited Company and changed its name to Fujian Mindong Electric Power Group Co., Ltd. in December 2025.
